coverage.name: First-time recipient
coverage.description: Almost every recipient is first-time and anonymous: no coach marks exist; orientation relies on sender line, field placeholders, Next Field and the legal disclosure paragraph shown in every signature/complete dialog.

coverage.notes: No coach marks or tour: grep "tour|coachmark|onboarding|walkthrough|joyride" across document-signing/, envelope-signing/ and routes/_recipient+ returns nothing. The Next Field + pending tooltip pair plays the same role a guided "Start" arrow does in other e-sign tools, so a tour is a recommendation, not a gap.

coverage.name: Offline
coverage.description: No offline banner. Field insert fails to generic toast (48), completion fails to generic toast (114), PDF fetch fails to error state (16). Mobile recipients on flaky data will hit this.
coverage.evidence: No offline detection anywhere: grep "navigator.onLine|useOnlineStatus|useNetworkState|addEventListener('online'|addEventListener('offline'" across apps/remix/app, packages/ui, packages/lib returns nothing; inventory state_patterns.offline is []. Field insert (#48), removal (#47), completion (#114) and PDF fetch (#16) each fall through to a generic destructive toast that never mentions connectivity.
coverage.gap_label: New offline banner + network detection needed
extends_from: root.tsx global banner pattern bg-destructive px-4 py-3 text-sm (apps/remix/app/root.tsx:163-164)
Button disabled:opacity-50 for Next Field / Complete (button.tsx:10)
TOAST_LIMIT=1 (use-toast.ts:6) so offline toast must not fight field toasts
coverage.notes: Collapses the offline sub-states that all need the same detector: PDF fetch offline, field insert/remove offline, completion offline, reconnect. Anonymous recipients on phones are the primary audience; today a dropped connection mid-signature reads as "something went wrong" with no cause and no cue to wait and retry. Minimum viable: window online/offline listeners + persistent warning banner + disable mutating buttons while offline.

coverage.name: Slow connection
coverage.description: Long PDF spinner with no progress; per-field spinner lingers; completion button spins until redirect. No timeouts or progress indicators.
coverage.evidence: Indeterminate handling exists: PdfViewerLoadingState 80vh Spinner at apps/remix/app/components/general/pdf-viewer/pdf-viewer-states.tsx:4-10, per-field Loader overlay (#42), Button loading prop (#106) — missing: no progress or slow-load messaging; grep "onProgress|AbortSignal.timeout" in pdf-viewer.tsx returns nothing (the only setTimeout at :382,486 is an idle timer for page rendering), and getDocument at :114 receives already-fetched bytes so the fetch itself has no progress callback
coverage.gap_label: Extend [PdfViewerLoadingState], add [determinate Progress fed by fetch/pdf.js onProgress + "still loading" hint after ~8s]
coverage.notes: On mobile data a multi-MB PDF behind a silent spinner for 20-40s is indistinguishable from a hang and drives abandonment before the first field is reached. Blocks exist (Progress primitive, spinner); they are not assembled for the PDF fetch.

coverage.name: Keyboard navigation
coverage.description: Field overlays are real buttons; dialogs trap focus; tabs have role=tab; PIN inputs autofocus. Gap: draw canvas has no keyboard alternative (Type tab is the fallback), color/zoom/undo buttons rely on focus-visible rings.
coverage.evidence: Field overlays are real <button> elements (document-signing-field-container.tsx:122-125,143), signature tabs use role=tablist/tab/tabpanel with aria-selected and focus-visible:ring-2 (packages/ui/primitives/signature-pad/signature-tabs.tsx:62,80-87,126), Radix Dialog traps focus, undo/zoom buttons carry focus-visible rings (signature-pad-draw.tsx:268,296) — missing: the draw <canvas> at signature-pad-draw.tsx:238-246 has no tabIndex or onKeyDown (pointer only), so when a sender disables the Type tab (#67) a keyboard-only recipient has no way to produce a signature; the Remove overlay button at field-container.tsx:143 is focusable but empty, so Tab lands on an unnamed control
coverage.gap_label: Extend [SignaturePad tabs], add [guaranteed keyboard path: keep Type tab available for keyboard/AT users or expose a visible "Use typed signature" fallback when draw-only]; Reuse [sr-only label on Remove button]
coverage.notes: Most of keyboard support is genuinely covered by the DS focus pattern; the hole is narrow but real for motor-impaired recipients on draw-only envelopes. Shares the field-button naming fix with #147.

coverage.name: Screen reader
coverage.description: Signature img has alt 'Signature for {name}'; undo/zoom have sr-only labels; widget chevron has aria-label; 2FA PinInput has aria-label. Gaps: field overlay buttons have no accessible name, remaining-count changes and toasts are not announced via live region, 'Signature is too small' is visual only.
coverage.evidence: Exists: img alt "Signature for {name}" (document-signing-signature-field.tsx:265), sr-only labels on Undo/Zoom (signature-pad-draw.tsx:300, signature-pad-upload.tsx:390,403), aria-label on sidebar toggle (page-view-v2.tsx:109,139), widget chevron (mobile-widget.tsx:46) and 2FA PinInput (access-auth-2fa-form.tsx:241); toasts pass through Radix Toast.Root (toast.tsx:46) which brings its own announcer — missing: the insert button (field-container.tsx:122-125) and Remove button (:143) are empty <button> elements with no text or aria-label, so every field announces as "button"; "Signature is too small" (signature-pad-draw.tsx:282) is a plain <Trans> in a div with no role=alert; the "N Fields Remaining" pill is not in a live region (grep "aria-live|role="status"" across document-signing/ and envelope-signing/ returns nothing)
coverage.gap_label: Extend [field overlay buttons], add [aria-label "{field type} for {recipient}, press to insert" / "Remove {field type}"]; Reuse [role=alert on too-small message, aria-live=polite on remaining count]
coverage.notes: Critical: a screen-reader recipient cannot tell which unnamed button is the signature field versus a date or checkbox, which blocks signing entirely. Building blocks are all in the DS; nothing new to design.
